titles: 2 · Confirm your email and sign in
captions: Welcome to Sert trust. In the next few minutes, you'll go from a brand new account to a verified digital certificate in your recipient's inbox.
Start by creating your organisation account. Enter your name, your work email and your organisation, choose a password, and accept the terms.
We send you a confirmation email. Click the link in it, then sign in. You land on your dashboard.

Next, design your certificate. Open Design Templates, choose New design, and pick a ready made layout. Give it a name, and the Design Studio opens. Add text or your logo, move things around, and save.
Now create an achievement. This is what you are awarding, like a course, a workshop or a qualification. Give it a name, a short description, and the criteria for earning it.
Time to issue. Pick the achievement, then add your recipients. Type them in one by one, or upload a spreadsheet saved as C S V, with a name and an email column. Check the list, and click Issue.
Each recipient gets an email from your organisation, with a link to their certificate. There is nothing to install, and no account to create.
The certificate page shows their name, your organisation and the achievement. Sert trust checks that it is genuine. It was signed by you, it hasn't been changed, and it hasn't been revoked.
Recipients can add it to LinkedIn in one click, download it, or share a link or a Q R code. Anyone who opens it can verify it on the spot.
Back on your dashboard, you can see every certificate you have issued, search them, and download any of them again.
That's it. Your first certificate, issued and verifiable, in a few minutes. Get started at sert trust dot app.
